root_cause: Original verified Supabase cron job #177 runs at 00:18/06:18/12:18/18:18 UTC, but original bg-social-metrics-sync upserted only one provider-social-metrics:<Amsterdam-day> record into powerhouse_runtime_events each execution. Example 2026-11-12 has four succeeded cron job runs and only one last daily event at 18:18. This destroyed independent readback of earlier per-run statuses/evidence; a day summary is not an append-only event or original downstream metric/learning consumer ACK. The SAME authorized Edge additionally generated snapshot_id/source_event_id=composio:<platform>:<provider-id>:<Amsterdam-day> and upserted each 6h GET by that shared daily ID, overwriting the original actual source observed_at and metrics. Real production shows only 12 Composio Instagram snapshots for 12 Instagram posts on 2026-11-12, all near 18:18 UTC even though original cron #177 ran at 00:18,06:18,12:18,18:18 UTC. Historical missing windows cannot be reconstructed from today's snapshot.
prevention_rule: Within the same original authorized Edge job #177 and existing powerhouse_runtime_events, record a distinct audited source execution under provider-social-metrics:run:<UUID> as event_type provider_social_metric_ingest_receipt, preserving true observed/error state, UTC six-hour slot and exact source outcome. Require an independently returned exact ID/status/evidence readback BEFORE updating existing provider-social-metrics:<Amsterdam-day> daily summary under its unchanged event_type. Distinct attempts have distinct receipts; never create a second cron, table, provider request, publication, metric, learning or fake consumer ACK. Do not treat healthy=true or HTTP 200 as evidence of 24/48/72h source-bound learning or revenue. For every actual future original scheduled provider observation, derive immutable per-provider/post source_event_id from verified original provider ID + UTC 6h slot, keep old YYYY-MM-DD event rows unchanged and use ignoreDuplicates:true to preserve first original source timestamp on a same-slot retry. The subsequent 24/48/72 ±6h consumer uses real observed_at, never synthetic backfill.
evidence: Read-only cron.job run details 2026-11-12T00:18,06:18,12:18,18:18 UTC, all succeeded; original provider event 'provider-social-metrics:2026-11-12' has only latest occurred_at 2026-11-12T18:18:25.4Z, no separate six-hour results.

Original bg-social-metrics-sync/index.ts used upsert({dedupe_key:'provider-social-metrics:'+day,...}) and event_type provider_social_metric_ingest; source event table has UNIQUE(dedupe_key), no separate original run ID.
Original social_learning_obligations 184 OPEN and 365 BRAIN CONTENT_HANDOFF OPEN; original Heartbeat 9 GREEN/6 RED. The source audit does not establish any extra provider metric/learning outcomes.
Original #171 and #177 are active; no second scheduler allowed. The new receipts are in the existing table and event type distinct to avoid double-counting daily consumer summaries.

Original read-only production social_metric_snapshots for 2026-11-12: 12 composio-instagram rows across 12 posts, observed_at within 18:18:07..18:18:16Z, source_event_id suffix 2026-11-12. Four original cron #177 source polls succeeded that UTC day. Duplicate snapshot ID had erased earlier poll windows.
risks: Adding audit events without original provider readback cannot prove actual missing historical results.
A successful source poll does not prove authentic time-bound post measurement, CRM conversion or applied learning.
Service-token and Vault access must remain unchanged; event receipts are accessible only to the original authorized writer.
